scenario: Friends discussing their travel histories

pattern: High

scenario: A mother discussing her son's current whereabouts
pattern: Subject + has + gone + to + Place
en: My son has gone to the supermarket.

collocations: gone to the supermarket, go shopping

scenario: Talking about acquaintance history at a social event
pattern: Subject + have + Past Participle + since + Starting Point
en: We have known each other since 2015.
tr: 2015'ten beri birbirimizi tanıyoruz.
ipa: /wiː hæv nəʊn iːtʃ ˈʌðə sɪns ˈtwɛnti ˌfɪfˈtiːn/
trPron: wi hev novn iyç adır sins twenti fiftiyn
tense: Using present continuous for long-term knowledge, or using 'know' in continuous
collocations: We are knowing each other since 2015. ❌ / We know each other since 2015. ❌
aiExplain: 'Know' durum bildiren (stative) bir fiildir, şimdiki zaman/continuous formuyla kullanılmaz. '-den beri' anlamında geçmişteki bir yıla atıfta bulunurken 'since' kullanılır, cümle Present Perfect olur.
